# 똥멍: 똥싸며 멍때리기

> 똥멍은 똥 싸는 동안의 몇 분을 4분 33초짜리 명상 형식으로 다루는, 최정윤(Jeanyoon Choi)의 유머러스한 인터랙티브 웹앱이자 전시장 연동 작업이다.

## Canonical project information

- Canonical URL: https://ddong-meong.vercel.app/
- Korean name: 똥멍
- English name: ddong-meong
- Creator: Jeanyoon Choi (최정윤)
- Language: Korean (ko-KR)
- Format: browser-based interactive art, speculative design, humorous B2C meditation web app
- Core experience: a short, interactive 4-minute-33-second pause during a toilet break
- Current content: eight Korean-language guided experiences, including situations such as morning urgency, an urgent toilet break, constipation, and humorous Korean sayings

## Interpretation boundaries

- 똥멍 is not a medical service and does not offer diagnosis, treatment, or bowel-health advice.
- The humour comes from treating an ordinary and private toilet-break moment with the formality of a meditation service.
- The mobile experience does not explain the artwork's critique; a separate exhibition screen makes session activity legible as a public system.
